summary: تم اختبار ميزة تبديل الفروع للمسؤول بنجاح. تم إصلاح خطأ في فلترة الإيرادات الشهرية في Dashboard. جميع الاختبارات نجحت (12/12 backend + UI tests).

fixed.issue: Dashboard month_revenue not filtering by branch for admin
fixed.fix: Added branch_filter condition to invoice_query in get_dashboard_stats endpoint

passed_tests: ✅ Admin can see branch selector in sidebar
✅ Admin can switch between branches (فندق الحمراء، فندق الضباب، الجيل)
✅ Dashboard stats update correctly when switching branches (members, revenue, coupons)
✅ Invoices page filters by selected branch
✅ Members page filters by selected branch
✅ Store/Coupons page filters by selected branch
✅ Admin can create coupon with specific branch
✅ Branch name displayed in coupon list
✅ Non-admin user does NOT see branch selector
✅ Non-admin user only sees their assigned branch data
✅ Dashboard revenue now correctly filters by branch (was bug - fixed)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Branch switching feature fully tested and working. Fixed bug where dashboard month_revenue was not filtering by branch for admin users. All 8 features tested: 1) Branch selector in sidebar (admin only), 2) Dashboard updates on branch switch, 3) Invoices filter by branch, 4) Members filter by branch, 5) Store/Coupons filter by branch, 6) Create coupon with specific branch, 7) Branch name in coupon list, 8) Non-admin cannot see branch selector. Test users created: admin (is_admin=true), test_branch_user (is_admin=false, branch=فندق الحمراء).
